title: A client's session in token and server mode
caption: What a client holds and when it refreshes (internal/session.js). Tokens live only in the client's memory and in what the integrator stores through onSessionRefreshed. The API side of the same story is customer_sessions (rotated_at, replaced_by_id, revoked_at, revoke_reason) for customers and staffsess:<familyId> in Redis for staff.

states.label: no tokens (key only)
states.detail: `accessToken` and `refreshToken` absent, `null` or `""`. Session results are reported to the hook but never kept: a server's shared anonymous client holds nobody's session.

states.label: access token only
states.detail: Non-empty string `accessToken`, no refresh token: never refreshes; adopts its own `auth.signIn` / `auth.refresh` / `auth.changePassword` results (lead decision 22g). The OTA admin's staff clients are this kind.

states.label: holding A + R
states.detail: Sends `Authorization: Bearer A`. A string `R` it held before a rotation leads to the newest pair forever; any other value only within 10 s (`ROTATION_WINDOW_MS`).

states.label: refresh in flight (family-wide per R)
states.detail: `POST /v1/auth/refresh` (or `/v1/console/auth/refresh` with `sessionKind: staff`) with `{ refreshToken: R }` and the API key only.

states.label: holding A' + R' (R recorded as replaced)
states.detail: `family.replaced` keeps the last 512 rotated refresh tokens; `onSessionRefreshed` (then `onStaffSessionRefreshed`) got the newest pair.

states.label: session expired / revoked
states.detail: Refresh refused with 401 (`REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID`, `REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED`): `onSessionExpired` once, every waiting call rejects with the `AuthenticationError`. Reuse revokes the whole family on the API.

transitions.label: 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED on a call that sent the session's token
auth.signIn / auth.refresh / auth.changePassword result adopted, or a family rotation it follows
someone presents R after the window → REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED
